face_convention: N/E/S/W are the cube's side contacts with the module turned exactly as drawn in its raw_orig_icon (rotation 0).
placement_convention: Every module is one cell tall; width_cells gives its width. A module can be turned in quarter steps and placed in any field cell unless it sets rotatable: false or a slot (the antenna bar only fits the antenna slot, as drawn).
connection_convention: Each entry in pinout.connections is either a two-terminal element or wire, {from, to, via}, or a multi-terminal element, {via, terminals: {terminal name: face}} (e.g. a bjt's base/collector/emitter). A polarized two-terminal element (symmetric: false) conducts from → to: a diode's anode is 'from' and its cathode 'to'; an electrolytic's + terminal is 'from'.

elements.name: block_001

pinout.source: src/model/catalogue.ts:r2k2-o (prior pass; its rotation 0 is Приложение 2's drawing, not necessarily this icon's)

elements.notes: Icon has the same fan-out as block_003 (lead to W, body, then lines from the far lead to N, E and S), and block_003's pinout is confirmed as a W–E resistor with E wired to N and S. So this is very likely the same T topology, and the catalogue's plain W–E span is incomplete.

elements.name: block_002

pinout.source: src/model/catalogue.ts:r12k-a (prior pass; its rotation 0 is Приложение 2's drawing, not necessarily this icon's)

elements.notes: Read the way block_003's confirmed icon reads (every line that reaches the rim is a contact), this icon shows a plain wire straight across W–E with the resistor hanging off it down to the bottom rim — i.e. W and E joined, resistor from that node to S. Doesn't match the catalogue's N–E hypothesis in this orientation; needs confirming.

elements.name: block_003
elements.notes: Electrically W is one node and N/E/S are one node, with the resistor between them, so it can be used straight through (W–E) or as a corner (W–N, W–S). The small ring on a stem under the resistor body is unexplained; blocks 004 and 006 have one too, so it isn't what tells the two 68 кОм modules apart. The kit's other 68 кОм module is block_004, drawn differently, so num_in_kit = 1.

elements.name: block_004
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 1. Second 68 кОм module (block_003 is the first); resistor drawn on a diagonal, with a small ring. Probably catalogue.ts:r68k-a.

elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 2. First of two 680 кОм modules; resistor drawn straight W–E like block_003. Probably catalogue.ts:r680k-o.

elements.name: block_006
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 3. Second 680 кОм module; plain W–E line with the resistor on a diagonal below it, like block_002, plus a small ring. Probably catalogue.ts:r680k-a.

elements.name: block_007

elements.name: block_008

elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 1. First of three 0,01 мкФ modules; capacitor drawn straight W–E with two diagonal lines, like block_003. Probably catalogue.ts:c10n-o.

elements.name: block_015
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, aluminium electrolytic type K50-6-1, 10 V, 20 µF
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 2. No tolerance is printed. Second 20 мкФ module; capacitor drawn straight W–E with one diagonal line up to the rim, and a + mark on the W side of the plates. Row order says catalogue.ts:c20u-a, but that entry is 'adjacent' while this is drawn like the straight-through ones (same mismatch as block_012).

elements.name: block_016
elements.eng_interpret: Two diodes, germanium point-contact type D9B
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 3. Two diodes in series W→S→E with the midpoint on S, so the module gives either diode alone or both in series; matches catalogue.ts:dd9b. The icon also has a line from the W side up to the top rim that the confirmed pinout doesn't include; it may be a plain W–N wire like block_003's, still to check.

elements.name: block_017
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 4. First of the kit's two transistors. The plain N–E wire makes the collector reachable on both N and E. Every line in the icon is accounted for: base to W, collector up to N, emitter down to S, and the chord from the top rim to the right rim. Terminals match catalogue.ts:q315-a, but the catalogue gives that module no E contact, so it's missing the N–E wire.

elements.name: block_018
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 5. Second transistor. Same terminal faces as block_017; the only difference is which leg also reaches E: here the emitter (S–E wire), and N–E is explicitly not connected. Every line in the icon is accounted for, including the chord from the bottom rim to the right rim. Contradicts catalogue.ts:q315-b, which has collector S and emitter N, and no E contact.

elements.name: block_019
elements.rus_orig_desc: Антенна магнитная. Сердечник 400НН-8×80 мм. Катушка L1 содержит 100+230 витков провода ПЭВ-2 0,16 мм, катушка L2 содержит 25 витков провода ПЭВ-2 0,16 мм
elements.eng_interpret: Magnetic (ferrite-rod) antenna. Core: ferrite grade 400NN, 8 × 80 mm. Coil L1: 100 + 230 turns of PEV-2 enamelled wire, 0.16 mm; coil L2: 25 turns of PEV-2 wire, 0.16 mm.
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_019-019_raw_table.png. One cell tall and six wide; fits only the antenna slot, as drawn. L1 is one winding tapped into 100 + 230 turns. No inductance is printed; catalogue.ts:ant estimates it from the turn counts. In the icon, L2 (short winding, top) sits above the tapped L1, and leads reach the top edge in several places and the right end, but none reaches the left end or the bottom edge; catalogue.ts:ant puts a contact on the left end, which this drawing doesn't show. Its contacts sit at positions along a six-cell bar, which the N/E/S/W face format can't express yet (SPEC.md §8 open question 4). Probably catalogue.ts:ant.
